changelog:
Initial release of Hive Task Router - intelligent task distribution system for OpenClaw.
Features:
- Automatic task type recognition (web/code/data/doc/chat)
- Smart model selection with auto-detection
- Fuzzy task clarification for vague requests
- Multi-provider support (Bailian, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google)
- 24-hour model validation cache for performance
- Parallel execution support for batch tasks
Performance: 3x faster for parallel research tasks compared to sequential execution.
